tips: Order of arms: case / motherboard / CPU / PSU first - they age slowest. RAM next. GPUs and HDDs LAST - both are the most volatile line items in this build.
PSU and UPS: buy new only. Everything else in the server can be used - but run a VRAM + 10-minute fan load test before you pay.
When CNY sits below the 8-week average, convert and place the big-ticket orders the same week. The dashboard flags this automatically.
Shipping is a fixed ~8,500 SAR - heavier carts lower cost per kilo. Consolidate furniture AND tech into ONE shipment.
Budget the full 15% import tax on goods value. Keep every receipt - customs math must be honest to stay painless.
Xianyu for parts (negotiate 10-15% down). Huaqiangbei / SEG for GPUs. Never pay before a live GPU-Z VRAM check.
Anti-cheat titles (Valorant, Fortnite, PUBG) refuse to run inside a VM - the dedicated 3060 Windows box is non-negotiable if those are your games.
Single 3090 = one full-quality gaming session at a time. Schedule local AI workloads around play, not during it.
Landing cost = goods + 15% tax + shipping share. If that total exceeds ~90% of the local price, do not ship it.
Hold back 10% of the 50K as contingency - freight quotes and FX both move. Surplus shown today is not free money.
Sea freight runs 3-6 weeks. Order Phase 1 (case/mobo/CPU/PSU) the day you land; verify GPU prices locally before committing Phase 3.
Sofas are the heaviest, bulkiest line item - measure every doorway, elevator and stair turn before ordering. A sofa that will not fit is scrap.
Bedroom and lighting gear is where China beats local retail hardest right now - same quality tier, roughly half the price after tax.
Compare the same SKU on 1688 vs Xianyu: factory-refurbished units often run 30-40% under retail with warranty still traceable.
